description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for five different model configurations, with the y-axis representing “Loss” on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and the x-axis representing “#Iteration” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000. The legend identifies five distinct lines: “Vanilla” (purple, solid line), “StrmLLM (n=64)” (blue, solid line), “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange, solid line), “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green, solid line), and “SepLLM (n=128)” (dark blue, solid line). All lines begin near a loss value of approximately 3.4 at iteration 0, then exhibit a rapid initial decline before leveling off. The “Vanilla” line decays most sharply and settles near a loss of 2.5. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” line follows a similar trajectory but remains slightly higher than “Vanilla” throughout. The “SepLLM (n=64)” and “SepLLM (n=64, H)” lines show comparable performance, both starting at around 3.3 and stabilizing near 2.55. The “SepLLM (n=128)” line starts slightly higher than the others at around 3.35 and ends near 2.55. All lines show a steady decline followed by a plateau, with no clear peaks or dramatic fluctuations beyond the initial rapid drop.
